translated_title: Today a Team of Rescuers and Medical Personnel Leaves Mexico for Venezuela to Help After Earthquakes: Sheinbaum
original_title: Hoy sale un equipo de rescatistas y personal de sanidad de México a Venezuela para ayudar tras sismos: Sheinbaum

meta_description: The first Sedena brigade of 250 soldiers, five dogs, and four aircraft responds to two strong quakes in north-central Venezuela, with more personnel to follow.
